question.text: Which of the following investment products offers tax benefits under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that investment in an Equity Linked Savings Scheme (ELSS) provides tax benefits under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act under the old tax regime, and lists ELSS among the Section 80C investment products. Liquid, overnight, and ultra-short duration funds are described as short-term debt fund categories used for parking surplus, not as Section 80C tax-saving products. The Trap: All four options are mutual fund schemes, which can make it easy to assume any equity-flavoured fund qualifies. Only ELSS is identified in the workbook as the mutual-fund product eligible for Section 80C; the short-term debt categories listed do not carry that benefit. Note: The Section 80C benefit for ELSS is available under the old tax regime as described in the workbook. Lock-in period details and comparisons with other 80C instruments are not part of the cited material and would need to be confirmed from separate sources.
